name: tract_id
description: Census tract GEOID (11 digits, 2020 tracts); source: Census TIGER/Line 2022

name: households
description: Total households, B08201_001; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: households_moe
description: Margin of error (90%) for households, B08201_001M; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: vehicle_deficit_households
description: Households with fewer vehicles than members (B08201_008, 014, 015, 020-022, 026-029); 4+-person households with 4+ vehicles counted as not short; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: vehicle_deficit_share
description: vehicle_deficit_households / households (0-1); null when no households; derived in src/transit_dependency.py

name: renter_households
description: Renter households with burden computed, B25070_001 minus B25070_011; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: renter_burdened
description: Renter households paying 30% or more of income on gross rent, B25070_007-010; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: owner_households
description: Owner households with burden computed, B25091_001 minus B25091_012 and B25091_023; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: owner_burdened
description: Owner households paying 30% or more of income on owner costs, with mortgage B25091_008-011 and without B25091_019-022; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: burden_share
description: (renter_burdened + owner_burdened) / (renter_households + owner_households), i.e. weighted by tenure (0-1); derived in src/transit_dependency.py

name: owner_median_burden_pct
description: Median owner costs as % of income, all owners, B25092_001; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: owner_median_burden_pct_mortgage
description: Median owner costs as % of income, with mortgage, B25092_002; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: owner_median_burden_pct_no_mortgage
description: Median owner costs as % of income, without mortgage, B25092_003; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: commute_transit_share
description: Workers commuting by public transportation, B08301_010 / B08301_001; validation only; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: commute_bus_share
description: Workers commuting by bus, B08301_011 / B08301_001; validation only; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: commute_walk_share
description: Workers who walk to work, B08301_019 / B08301_001; validation only; source: Census API ACS 2020-2024 5-year estimates

name: geometry
description: Tract polygon in WGS84; source: Census TIGER/Line 2022 (tl_2022_36_tract)
